name: FX_Fire_Burst

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 8 x 8 frames of 256 px, row by row from the top left

source_note: the frames are generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the dusk review scene with the mid frame on a card
dresses: fire burst (the "atomic" frames), one shot of 64 frames: a column of fire carrying a rolling cap up to about 4.5 m, cooling to smoke
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, no effect asset built
known_weaknesses: PARTIAL. The mushroom is a cap, two side rolls and a stem drawn in profile with noise on them: it does not turn over like a real vortex ring, and the base has no ground fire or dust skirt. A flipbook, not an effect: 64 frames of 256 px on one 2048 px atlas for a camera-facing billboard. It is drawn in 2D, so it casts no light, has no depth against the scene (soft-particle fade is engine work), and seen from above it is still a side view. The beauty render is the mid frame on an emissive card at dusk, not a volume. No Niagara system, material or light is authored here.
